name: Adspirer Search Ads
description: PPC and paid search agent for Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads). Research keywords and competitor ads, review search performance, find wasted spend, audit conversion tracking, and plan, create and optimize search campaigns, with your approval before any change that affects spend.
accessRequirements: An Adspirer account and admin access to at least one Google Ads or Microsoft Advertising account (read-only access is enough for reporting).
examplePrompts: Pull my Google Ads performance for the last 90 days by campaign: impressions, clicks, spend and conversions, with totals.
Show my Google Analytics sessions and conversions by traffic source for the last 90 days.
List my Microsoft Advertising campaigns with their status, daily budgets and bid strategies.
In my Google Ads account, show the search terms from the last 90 days that spent money with no conversions, highest spend first, and suggest negative keywords. Don't add them yet.

Create a paused Microsoft Advertising Performance Max campaign for my online watch store at $50 a day, with headlines and descriptions you write, my landing page and my images. Show me the plan before creating anything.
